headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings. Max size text-5xl on desktop.

body.usage: Use leading-relaxed for long text, clean legible sizes. Left align for better readability.

typography.instructions: Import 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css.

rules: Use primary sparingly, only for key actions and active states.
Ensure tinting of grays (Slate or Zinc) to avoid pure #808080 or #000000.
Hover state color must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft diffuse ambient shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]. Avoid harsh generic shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for primary action buttons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark) for sticky headers and mobile bottom navs. Mandatory 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Dashboard widgets should use 'Clay & Crisp' neumorphism or flat solid surfaces with sharp inner contrasts.

guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Distinct hover states with subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5).
guidelines.cards: Go flat, rectangular or slightly rounded, dense styles. Avoid generic card overload. Use generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
guidelines.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom for mobile (Peminjam & Pendana) using glassmorphism. Use Phosphor icons (Duotone).
guidelines.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for all financial actions (Funding claim, Transfer, Repayment). Clean typography, bold action buttons.
guidelines.badges: Soft colored backgrounds with bold dark text. rounded-md, text-xs, uppercase, wide tracking (tracking-widest).
guidelines.inputs: Use Shadcn Form/Input. Never use native raw inputs.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_superadmin: High density grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Span summary cards 1 col, charts 2 or 3 cols. No jagged bottoms (use h-full).
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first_views: Single column grid. Edge-to-edge or subtly padded containers. Bottom padding pb-24 required to account for bottom nav.
grids_and_layouts.tables: Edge-to-edge on mobile. Left-align text, right-align monetary values (IDR).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward motion using framer-motion.
motion.interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on active (scale-[0.98]).
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for loan lists/history.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-loan-btn').

login_background.description: Abstract architecture minimal grey digital wallpaper for login split screen side panel

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an end-to-end PWA money lending application (SaaS + Mobile-first) with 4 roles: Superadmin, Admin, Peminjam, Pendana.
Implement full flow: Registration -> Verification -> Limit Set -> Loan Request -> Funder Take -> Transfer -> Confirm -> Repay -> Lunas.
Use Rupiah (Rp) formatting for all currencies. Ensure Indonesian context.
Mobile-first design for Borrower and Funder interfaces, featuring a sticky Bottom Navigation bar.
Superadmin dashboard needs 14 summary cards and useful Recharts graphs.
Admin dashboard focuses on 'Action Required' tasks.
Provide clear Empty States, Loading Skeletons, and Confirmation Dialogs for critical financial actions.
Integrate Shadcn UI components extensively (Tables, Tabs, Dialogs, Forms) but customize them to remove the generic look.
Implement Audit Log and Settings (General/Loan/Telegram) for Superadmin.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it (e.g., Dropdowns).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Never center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
